name: User Registered
description: Fires when a new user completes registration via email or social login.

name: User Logged In
description: Fires when a user successfully authenticates (email, Google, or Apple).

name: Business Listed
description: Fires when a provider submits a new free or booking-tier directory listing.

name: Email Verified
description: Fires when a user successfully verifies their email address via token.

name: Password Reset Completed
description: Fires when a user successfully resets their password using a reset token.

name: Booking Created
description: Fires when a consumer creates a new appointment booking.

name: Booking Payment Initiated
description: Fires when a user triggers checkout for a booking, creating a Stripe payment intent.

name: Booking Paid
description: Fires when a booking payment is confirmed as successful.

name: Booking Refunded
description: Fires when a paid booking is refunded.

name: Counter Payment Recorded
description: Fires when a provider records an in-person (counter) payment for a booking.

name: Order Created
description: Fires when a consumer places a new product order.

name: Order Paid
description: Fires when an order payment is confirmed as successful.

name: Order Refunded
description: Fires when a paid order is refunded.

name: Enquiry Submitted
description: Fires when a visitor submits an enquiry to a provider from their listing page.

name: Retreat Created
description: Fires when a provider publishes a new retreat listing.

name: Provider Connect Onboarded
description: Fires when a provider completes Stripe Connect onboarding and is payment-enabled.

name: Health Profile Saved
description: Fires when a user saves or updates their dosha / health profile.
